description: Route a free-text GI ask to the Gastrologer object that owns it: a governed claim, teaching module, instrument (IBS-SSS/GERD-Q), atlas region, prep-timeline workflow, or relationship. Returns a confidence-ordered routing decision (resolved | ambiguous | needs_review) with canonical URLs — it routes, it does not answer. Unmatched asks are recorded as coverage-gap signals that drive what the corpus builds next.

ask.description: free-text information need, e.g. "current guidance for Barrett's surveillance"

name: resolve_ask
